rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who acts quickly on feelings without thinking things through.

example.english: He is impulsive and often quits his job without thinking things through.
example.traditional: 佢個人好衝動，成日未諗清楚就辭職。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 cung1 dung6 seng4 jat6 mei6 nam2 cing1 co2 zau6 ci4 zik1

rows.jyutping: m4 ging1 daai6 nou5 zau6 V
rows.note: Use this for an impulsive action specifically done without stopping to think, rather than for a general personality trait.

example.english: They were impulsive and quit their job yesterday without thinking it through, so now they are looking for work everywhere.
example.traditional: 佢尋日唔經大腦就辭咗份工，搞到而家周街搵工。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cam4 jat6 m4 ging1 daai6 nou5 zau6 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1 gaau2 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zau1 gaai1 wan2 gung1
